description: SIDM Run 3 signal grid: 6 M_Bs x 3 M_Zd x 5 ctau x 2 channels = 180 points, over 4 Run 3 eras.
how_to_run_one_point: 1. Pick the era's chain JSON above and the cell's gridpack (one per M_Bs,M_Zd,channel).
2. Run the chain to AODSIM via runFactory --host lpc: see 'Run one point on LPC' in sidm_run3/README.md (the validated recipe; it delivers GRIDPACK/CTAU to the job).
3. Run sidm_run3/run_llpnano.sh <AODSIM> <llpnano_year_by_era[era]> on the AODSIM for the nano.
See sidm_run3/example/example_run_one.sh for a standalone worked example.
